title: Tiny Casino
description: Adds a small casino GUI to Minecraft. Client-side only, does not affect gameplay.
body:
## 🎰 Tiny Casino

A small slot machine game built right into Minecraft! Press F10 anywhere in-game to open the casino, spin the slots, unlock achievements, and chase the jackpot.

## 🌐 Client-side only

Works on any server including vanilla. **Does not affect gameplay.**

- **Client-side only**
- **Jackpot system**
- **Pause on/off when opening in singleplayer**
- **English & Russian**
